text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The clinical picture of an 11-year history of chronic cough with copious purulent sputum, morning predominance, and recurrent bronchitis in a non-smoker is classic for this condition. The spirometry and sputum culture results will likely confirm airway obstruction and bacterial colonization, but the diagnosis is strongly supported by your history alone. I recommend a High-Resolution CT scan of the chest to visualize the characteristic "tram-track" bronchial walls and varicose bronchi, which are pathognomonic for bronchiectasis.
